## INCIDENT REPORT

**Event Date:** 2024-11-26  
**Analyst:** Network Forensics  
**Confidence:** High (signature-confirmed via IDS)

### Victim Host

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| IPv4 Address | 10.11.26.183 |
| MAC Address | d0:57:7b:ce:fc:8b |
| Hostname | DESKTOP-B8TQK49 |
| Logged-in User | oboomwald |
| LAN Subnet | 10.11.26.0/24 |

### Malware Family

**NetSupport RAT** (Remote Access Trojan)  
**Attribution Confidence:** Signature-confirmed  
**Evidence:** IDS alerts "ETPRO TROJAN NetSupport RAT CnC Activity" (Event 3.4022) and "Malicious NetSupport Rat CnC Checkin" (Event 3.4023) from Suricata

### Indicators of Compromise

#### Primary C2 Endpoint
- **Type:** C2 Endpoint
- **Value:** 194.180.191.64:443
- **Protocol:** HTTP (unencrypted) over TCP port 443
- **Evidence:** 59 POST requests to http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm with bare-IP host header, starting 2024-11-26T08:50:45 UTC. Responses contain encrypted C2 commands (CMD=ENCD format). Beaconing interval: ~60 seconds.

#### Malicious Domain
- **Type:** Domain
- **Value:** modandcrackedapk.com
- **Evidence:** DNS query logged 2024-11-26T08:50:14 UTC from victim to local DNS (10.11.26.3). Domain resolves to 193.42.38.139. IDS alerts "ET CURRENT_EVENTS ZPHP Domain in DNS Lookup" and "ET CURRENT_EVENTS ZPHP Domain in TLS SNI".

#### Secondary C2 IP (Domain Resolution)
- **Type:** C2 Endpoint
- **Value:** 193.42.38.139:443
- **Evidence:** DNS A record for modandcrackedapk.com. TLS ClientHello with SNI to modandcrackedapk.com targeting this IP.

#### Geolocation Lookup Endpoint
- **Type:** C2 Endpoint
- **Value:** 104.26.1.231:80
- **Protocol:** HTTP
- **URI:** /location/loca.asp
- **Evidence:** GET request from 10.11.26.183 at 2024-11-26T08:50:45 UTC. IDS alert "ET POLICY NetSupport GeoLocation Lookup Request". Identifies the victim's geolocation to the attacker.

#### Malicious URL
- **Type:** URL
- **Value:** http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm
- **Evidence:** Target of 59 POST requests (C2 check-ins). Responses contain encrypted command payloads (36-61 bytes per response).

### Lateral Movement & Exploitation Attempts

The victim (10.11.26.183) attempted exploitation of the local gateway/domain controller (10.11.26.3):

| Alert | Target | Port | Evidence |
|-------|--------|------|----------|
| EFSR RPC Attack | 10.11.26.3 | 445 | EfsRpcOpenFileRaw M1 at 2024-11-26T08:49:55 UTC |
| SMBv1 Exploitation | 10.11.26.3 | 139 | NTMLSSP unicode asn1 overflow attempt at 2024-11-26T08:50:10 UTC |
| SMB IPC$ Access | 10.11.26.3 | 139 | IPC$ share enumeration at 2024-11-26T08:50:10 UTC |
| SMB DOS Attack | 10.11.26.3 | 139 | SMB_COM_TRANSACTION Max Data Count DOS at 2024-11-26T08:50:10 UTC |

### Incident Summary

User "oboomwald" on workstation DESKTOP-B8TQK49 (10.11.26.183) is infected with NetSupport RAT. The infection was likely delivered via a fake software/cracked APK download from the modandcrackedapk.com domain (ZPHP malware family indicator). The RAT established persistent C2 communication with 194.180.191.64:443, beaconing HTTP POST requests to /fakeurl.htm at 60-second intervals starting 2024-11-26T08:50:45 UTC. The infected host also probed the local domain controller (10.11.26.3) using multiple SMB and RPC exploitation techniques (EFSR, SMBv1 NTMLSSP overflow, IPC$ enumeration), indicating lateral movement intent.
